question: Contá los fármacos distintos que se prueban en ensayos clínicos de mieloma múltiple.

attempts.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT td.parent_chembl_id)
FROM linking.trial_drug td
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_condition tc
  JOIN mesh.ancestor a ON a.id = tc.mesh_id
  JOIN mesh.descriptor md ON md.id = a.ancestor_id AND md.label = 'Multiple Myeloma'
  WHERE tc.nct_id = td.nct_id)
